templates.text: Sudden head turn to the side → delayed, partial attempt to right the head, then a weak, low-pitched cry.
Arm extended by examiner → slow, fluttering finger flexion, followed by a faint, breathy vocalization.
Foot stroked along outer edge → toes curl weakly after a {second} second pause, leg does not fully withdraw.
Hand brought to midline → fingers brush mouth briefly, rooting attempt is incomplete and fades.
Gentle pressure on sole → a sluggish, partial plantar grasp, releasing before full tension.
Sudden loss of trunk support → a slow, tremulous Moro fragment, arms fall back limply.
Cheek stroked near mouth → head turns fractionally, mouth opens slightly, then movement stalls.
Leg lifted and released → limb descends slowly with minimal corrective extension, a soft whimper follows.
Palmar grasp elicited → weak, inconsistent finger pressure that ebbs within {seconds} seconds.
Nose lightly obstructed → delayed, shallow head turn to clear airway, accompanied by a thin, strained cry.
Torso tilted sideways → incomplete righting response, a faint grunt of effort, then stillness.
Heel pressed against surface → feeble, abbreviated stepping motion that lacks coordination.
Mouth touched with fingertip → weak, uncoordinated suckling motion that ceases abruptly.
Sudden loud noise nearby → a slow blink, a faint startle quiver in the limbs, no full cry.
Arm restrained gently → a lethargic attempt to pull free, resulting in a muffled, discontented sound.
Placed in prone position → a delayed, partial effort to lift the head, lasting only a moment.
Sole scratched lightly → toes splay weakly, foot twitches, then falls back to neutral.
Chin supported then released → head nods forward with a slow, dampened bobbling motion.
Hand brushed against crib sheet → fingers make a slow, raking motion that lacks purposeful grip.
Light jostle of the bassinet → eyes open slowly, a quiet, wavering vocalization emerges.
Knee tapped for reflex → leg extends with reduced force and speed, reflex arc seems sluggish.
Nape of neck touched → a faint, delayed shoulder shrug, followed by a sigh-like exhalation.
Attempt to elicit crawling reflex → one leg makes a feeble push, the other remains motionless.
Sudden bright light → eyelids squeeze shut slowly, face grimaces with a delayed, soft whine.
Gentle traction on arms → head lags considerably, only partial flexion against the pull.
Foot dorsiflexed quickly → a slow, incomplete withdrawal, the cry is a faint, breathy protest.
Cheek stimulus repeated → rooting attempt grows weaker each time, culminating in a quiet fuss.
Held upright with feet touching surface → legs bear minimal weight, buckling after a brief moment.
Fingers uncurled from grasp → they close again weakly, then relax fully as if fatigued.
Mild vestibular input from rocking → a disorganized limb movement, then a low, arrhythmic vocalization.
